name: Saiga Arata
source:
"Damn! The power of darkness is running amok!"

A chunnibyou who is easily teased because of his behavior and clothes. However, he
has a straightforward and hard-working personality. He's the type to fall in love and gets dumped immediately after confessing. His magical abilities are cheats, but his control of them is poor and he often goes out of control.

He has a lot of respect for Niki and is the #1 member of his fan club. He one-sidedly views Kaito as a rival and dislikes him.

Sign: Taurus
Likes: Niki, cooking
Dislikes: Eggplants
Power: All

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
